# Docs

Shared reference for humans and agents. Read this index first and open only what you need.

- `domain/` - what the system is for: concepts, rules, behavior in user terms
- `architecture/` - how it is built: components, boundaries, conventions
- `decisions/` - ADRs: one decision per file, immutable once accepted

Manage with `docs-axi` (search, new, update, check). Keep files small and single-topic; link instead of repeating.

## Decisions

- [0001 Task state and dependencies live in tasks-axi](decisions/0001-task-state-and-dependencies-live-in-tasks-axi.md) - Why plans use tasks-axi for step state and dependencies instead of checkbox lists (accepted)
- [0002 Docs are edited directly, no delta-spec merge](decisions/0002-docs-are-edited-directly-no-delta-spec-merge.md) - Why docs/ is changed in place and archived changes are history only (accepted)
- [0003 Agents read and write docs by section through the CLI](decisions/0003-agents-read-and-write-docs-by-section-through-the-cli.md) - Why docs-axi and change-axi edit single sections instead of whole files (accepted)
- [0004 Plans are committed on main, steps run in a worktree](decisions/0004-plans-are-committed-on-main-steps-run-in-a-worktree.md) - Why plan approval is the main-branch commit and implementation happens in a treehouse worktree (accepted)
- [0005 Owns lists the files a step edits](decisions/0005-owns-lists-the-files-a-step-edits.md) - Why steps declare a write set and how it is used for parallel safety (accepted)
- [0006 Agent launch uses a command template](decisions/0006-agent-launch-uses-a-command-template.md) - Why enter runs a configurable command template instead of per-agent adapters (accepted)
- [0007 Agent profiles and step tiers extend the launch template](decisions/0007-agent-profiles-and-step-tiers-extend-the-launch-template.md) - Why agent launch gains harness/model/effort profiles and per-step tiers (accepted)
- [0008 Run launches ready steps as herdr tabs](decisions/0008-run-launches-ready-steps-as-herdr-tabs.md) - Why run opens one herdr tab per step under the current workspace and stops per wave (proposed)
- [0009 Docs layout is config; ADR section stays a fixed type](decisions/0009-docs-layout-is-config-adr-section-stays-a-fixed-type.md) - Why docs folder and sections are configurable while the ADR section keeps fixed numbering and status rules (accepted)
- [0010 Commits are conventional with a Change trailer](decisions/0010-commits-are-conventional-with-a-change-trailer.md) - Tool and agent commits use conventional commit format; the change slug moves to a Change trailer (accepted)
- [0011 ADRs are read through the adr subcommand](decisions/0011-adrs-are-read-through-the-adr-subcommand.md) - Why ADR list, search and add live under docs-axi adr and status filtering is ADR-only (accepted)
- [0012 ADR references carry number and slug and clashes are guarded](decisions/0012-adr-references-carry-number-and-slug-and-clashes-are-guarded.md) - Why ADR refs use ADR-NNNN-slug, renumber rewrites them, and commit-plan and finish fail on duplicate numbers (accepted)
- [0013 Unplanned backlog items use their own kinds and are promoted by change-axi new](decisions/0013-unplanned-backlog-items-use-their-own-kinds-and-are.md) - Why ideas, bugs and chores are separate backlog kinds, adopted into kind change by new, and how deprioritized and rejected work is handled (proposed)
